corrections.issue: No first-class Player Character layer; controllable actors were effectively Living NPCs.
corrections.correction: Added persistent player profiles and separate runtime-derived PLAYER_AVATAR records supporting CREATED and CANONICAL modes.

corrections.issue: No deterministic player command stream suitable for authoritative execution.
corrections.correction: Added ownership-scoped client sequence validation, server command ordering, conflict rejection and idempotent replay.

corrections.issue: Mouse backend exposed vector movement but not ARPG click-to-move intent.
corrections.correction: Added local pointer destinations, persistent movement intent, tick-driven arrival, collision blocking and pointer primary routing.

corrections.issue: Initial active-profile logic was global and would prevent future simultaneous multiplayer controllers.
corrections.correction: Changed activation rule to one active profile per controller_scope while preserving single-player behavior.

corrections.issue: Multiple profiles could represent the same canonical character identity in one world.
corrections.correction: Canonical character profiles now require a Master character ref, preserve Master name, and reject duplicate canonical identity profiles.

corrections.issue: Country inventory reconciliation repeatedly rescanned all NPCs for every city/block, producing excessive profile-creation cost.
corrections.correction: Added one-pass NPC locality indexes and reused block-local lists during subregion reconciliation.

corrections.issue: Optimized shared-world unit harness initially submitted obsolete controller_scope values.
corrections.correction: Kept runtime ownership enforcement intact and fixed the tests to submit the profile's actual controller_scope.

corrections.issue: First JSON unit-report runner attempted to import directory 03_TESTS as a Python package.
corrections.correction: Changed report runner to import the test file explicitly with importlib; regenerated report at 12/12 PASS.
